whenToUse: A compact newsletter or waitlist signup inside a page: a hero card, a sidebar, the end of an article, a podcast page.
Anywhere the app wants one email field with the same server contract as ContactForm (URL or server action, honeypot, KVKK notice).
avoidWhen: A full-width signup section with its own heading — use cta (variant newsletter) or the footer newsletter.
Asking for more than an email — use contact-form or form fields.
a11y: Visible label (or a screen-reader-only one with hideLabel); errors tied with aria-describedby and aria-invalid, focus moves to the field on an invalid submit.
Success replaces the form with a focused status; server errors are a focused alert. The privacy checkbox is never pre-checked.
